title: Glowing yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffee88' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa22' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5566'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc1133'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG2' cx='40%' cy='65%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8899'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#dd2244'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- string -->
  <line x1='50' y1='2' x2='50' y2='34' stroke='#ffe9a0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- top half body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <!-- bottom half body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyG2)'/>

  <!-- rim highlights so halves read apart -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0d8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M22 52 Q50 60 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc55' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- center axle hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='9' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='4' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- sparkle on hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- cute face glow dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 55 56 50' fill='none' stroke='#fff6c0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little shine streaks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.45' transform='rotate(-25 34 38)'/>
</svg>
